metadata.question:
Was there more visible turbudity around location (33.710618, 136.025799) than location (33.884848, 136.367495
) in September 15,2018, as captured by MODIS Terra?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Terra (MOD09GA or MOD09A1 for surface reflectance) - Date: September 15, 2018 - Two locations: (33.710618, 136.025799) and (33.884848, 136.367495) - For turbidity: use bands that indicate water clarity/suspended sediments 2. Masking strategy: - Since we're measuring turbidity (water quality), we should mask clouds but keep water pixels - Use QA bands if available to filter low-quality pixels - Turbidity can be approximated using red/NIR bands or specific turbidity indices 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Low turbidity values are valid (clear water) - C1: No images found for the date - C2: No valid pixels after masking (all clouds) - C3: Calculation returns null/invalid - Compare turbidity at both locations: if location1 > location2, answer A; else B For turbidity, I'll use the red band (sur_refl_b01) or a simple turbidity index. MODIS Terra daily product (MOD09GA) should have data for this specific date. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the two locations const loc1 = ee.Geometry.Point([136.025799, 33.710618]); const loc2 = ee.Geometry.Point([136.367495, 33.884848]); // Define date const date = '2018-09-15'; const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); // Load MODIS Terra Daily Surface Reflectance let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(loc1.union(loc2)); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS Terra images found for September 15, 2018'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the first (and likely only) image const image = collection.first(); // Use red band (sur_refl_b01) as turbidity proxy - higher values indicate more turbidity const redBand = image.select('sur_refl_b01'); // Create a simple cloud mask using state_1km QA band const qa = image.select('state_1km'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // Clear sky const maskedRed = redBand.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate turbidity (red band reflectance) at location 1 const turb1Result = maskedRed.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: loc1, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const turb1 = turb1Result.get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo(); // Calculate turbidity at location 2 const turb2Result = maskedRed.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: loc2, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const turb2 = turb2Result.get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo(); console.log(`Location 1 (33.710618, 136.025799) turbidity: ${turb1}`); console.log(`Location 2 (33.884848, 136.367495) turbidity: ${turb2}`); // Check for invalid results if (turb1 === null || turb2 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values returned'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(turb1) || isNaN(turb2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - NaN values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare turbidity values if (turb1 > turb2) { console.log('Location 1 has more turbidity than Location 2'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Location 1 does not have more turbidity than Location 2'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
